p.PROJECT-BUILDS-A-TOOL-THAT-MANAGES-ITSEL: This project builds a tool that manages itself — a self-updating CLI, an installer, a version manager, or a package system.

p.THE-LESSONS-CATALOG-IS-INSTALLED: The **tool design lessons** catalog is installed: numbered, self-contained lessons, each one paid for by shipping such a tool and the ecosystem around it.

p.READ-THE-GOVERNING-LESSON-FIRST: Before you design an activation model, an install pipeline, an identity scheme, a durable-environment edit, or a package format, read the lesson that governs it **first**.

p.the-law-is-one-line-the-rationale-is-why: The law is one line; the rationale is why it is not negotiable.

facts.POINTER-PACKAGING-LESSONS: Packaging — what ships, what identity is, the bootstrap: @spec://org.vibevm.world/tool-design-lessons/flows/tool-design-lessons/packaging-lessons#root.

p.index-and-maxims-pointer: The index and the cross-cutting maxims: @spec://org.vibevm.world/tool-design-lessons/flows/tool-design-lessons/TOOL-DESIGN-LESSONS#root.

facts.NEVER-MAKE-AN-ENVIRONMENT-VARIABLE-THE-S: Never make an environment variable the source of truth for the active version — env is frozen at process start; read a live pointer file each launch instead.
facts.NEVER-OVERWRITE-A-FILE-THAT-MAY-BE-IN-US: Never overwrite a file that may be in use — write a new instance directory and flip a pointer.
facts.NEVER-CONTENT-HASH-GIGABYTES-TO-ESTABLIS: Never content-hash gigabytes to establish identity — count instances and detect change cheaply.
facts.NEVER-SHIP-PROSE-DESCRIBING-TOOLING-THE-: Never ship prose describing tooling the consumer does not receive — ship the runtime.
facts.NEVER-LET-A-PACKAGES-IDENTITY-INCLUDE-BU: Never let a package's identity include build artifacts — identity is the source.
